title: Lightbox browses the whole list and deep-links a take
gap: AssetInspector.tsx:57 calls openPreview([one item]), so the ←/→ support that components/PreviewLayer.tsx:155-156 already has never fires. The selected take is not in the URL (lib/shell/state.tsx writeParams carries only view, tab, sp and cp), so a teammate cannot be sent a link to a take.
target: Open the preview with the current filtered list and index, and add Recreate and Use as reference to the lightbox bar. Add an 'asset' param to writeParams/readParams so /suites?sp=takes&asset=<id> selects and previews that take.
